channel.description: Latest articles from The College Fix (thecollegefix.com)

item.title: Depicting Jesus as white has some academics upset. But it shouldn’t.
item.description: The portrayal of Jesus varies widely across cultures, reflecting creativity and personal connections rather than exclusion.

item.title: ‘Spiritual hunger’: Pitt student ministry draws 600 to worship, baptism
item.description: A recent surge in college students embracing Christianity is evident at the University of Pittsburgh, where the Pitt Purpose ministry drew over 600 attendees for a baptism and worship service.

item.title: Miami college approves land deal for Trump library after transparency lawsuit
item.description: Miami Dade College's Board of Trustees has again approved a land transfer for Donald Trump's presidential library, after a lawsuit alleged violations of Florida's Sunshine Law.

item.title: Christian university in California denies TPUSA chapter, cites ‘MAGA connection’
item.description: Vanguard University of Southern California denied a Turning Point USA chapter as part of a new “apolitical” policy that bans religious, ideological, and political clubs. item.description: Loyola University Maryland’s Department of English recently announced its commitment to “anti-racism,” claiming literature promotes “white supremacy.” “Literature and the literary canons have been used to validate white supremacy,” the department’s website states. item.title: ‘Whoreship and Prayer’ burlesque show inside Vassar Chapel mocks Christianity, Catholicism
item.description: Performances and advertisements draw criticism, concern from some students.

item.title: Chinese UMich researcher deported after smuggling in ‘noxious fungus’
item.description: Federal law enforcement deported a Chinese University of Michigan researcher who pled guilty for her role in bring in a crop fungus to the United States.

item.title: Lawmakers demand changes at U. Oklahoma after student’s Bible essay got a zero
item.description: Oklahoma lawmakers, frustrated by bias against conservatives and Christians in higher education, are threatening funding cuts to the University of Oklahoma.

item.title: Harvard professor who was ‘hunting rats’ near synagogue agrees to leave U.S.
item.description: Visiting Harvard Law professor Carlos Portugal Gouvea was arrested for shooting a pellet gun near a synagogue during Yom Kippur and has agreed to voluntarily deport to Brazil.

item.title: Hofstra U. black students: ‘fear’ and ‘frustration’ due to ‘multiple instances’ of racism this fall
item.description: Hofstra University black students express "fear" and "frustration" this fall due to multiple instances of racism, including graffiti incidents. Students report feeling unsafe and undervalued, with allegations of biased treatment from faculty. The Black Leaders Advocating for Change seek to address these ongoing racial issues, while university officials struggle with communication and transparency.
